title: Intercomparison of deep learning models in predicting streamflow patterns: insight from CMIP6.
summary: The primary hydrology study compares deep-learning models against observed discharge in a specified basin and uses the best-performing model to project streamflow under CMIP6 scenarios. The projection is scenario-dependent and unverified against future observations. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
